title: objectstack start exits on SIGTERM in about 130 ms while its serve child keeps running (suspected; confirm on the image)
body:
repo:cloud#3 · os-warren · session_01JQwxbZqfEd7pcckjz3pGqn

Source: the multi-replica HA drill of cloud#4152 (PR cloud#4288), complete local run 20261110-073953 (cloud#4152 comment 6764315091), os-dev-report 6764331402. Parent: cloud#3814 (HA tier 1); inventory `docs/design/multi-replica-stateful-inventory.md`.

## What happens
On the drill's local target, SIGTERM to the `objectstack start` process exits it with 0 in 129 ms while its `serve` child stays alive (the drill had to kill it). Under Docker, with start as PID 1, that exit would kill the child unflushed, so no drain reaches the server on `docker stop`.

## To do first
Confirm on the released image (Compose target), since the local target spawns differently.

## Expected
`start` forwards SIGTERM to its child and exits only after the child drains (bounded), so a rolling restart drains in-flight requests.

Inventory row 31 (drain). Evidence: probe P15 `drain.exitedIn`, `leftoverChildKilled=true`.
